svg.aria-label: The full mode of the paper-review-panel skill. Boxes: Field analyst: the Reviewer Configuration Card (agent); You confirm the reviewer configuration (stop); EIC, 2 calls (agent); Methodology reviewer, 2 calls (agent); Domain reviewer, 2 calls (agent); Perspective reviewer, 2 calls (agent); Devil's Advocate reviewer, 2 calls (agent); Editorial synthesizer: the Editorial Decision and the Revision Roadmap (agent); EIC, resumed: the coaching question, only for a revision decision (stop).

svg.text: The five reviewers start at once, each in 2 calls under the sprint contract. The other modes start these roles. Re-review: the field analyst, the EIC and the editorial synthesizer. Quick:

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the field analyst and the EIC. Methodology-focus: the field analyst, the EIC and the methodology reviewer. Guided: the field analyst and the five reviewers, then the EIC's dialogue.
